Enterprise_sales_assist and referral_incentive are not targeted at the acute SMB/activation problems this quarter. Given only one experimental slot and competing pressures, I default to the best-evidenced, lowest-risk lever (onboarding simplification) rather than reactively matching competitor pricing, while flagging that the pricing question needs a dedicated retention-aware experiment later.
